rationale: The agent changed the payment method on the pending order without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating the confirmation requirement. The agent also failed to provide the requested gift card balance or explicitly state whether the gift card could be applied to the order. Authentication beyond looking up by email is not evident, and it’s unclear that the order was verified as belonging to the user. Additionally, the stated refund timeframe (5–7 business days) is unsupported by tool outputs. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
